cases.evidence: The commit added read_resume_position and changed the SPA bookmark handler to call it.
cases.summary: Reader resume arbitration had to be wired into the SPA bookmark endpoint.

cases.evidence: The commit introduced exact_resume and changed read_resume_position to call it for an exact device span.
cases.summary: Exact device resume conversion had to be consumed by reader-position arbitration.

cases.evidence: The commit introduced custom sort resolution and changed the classic magic-shelf handler to consume it.
cases.summary: Custom-column sort resolution had to reach the classic magic-shelf handler.

cases.evidence: The helper signature gained the shelf argument and the API shelf-add handler changed its call.
cases.summary: Shelf-owner membership preparation required its API caller to change.

cases.evidence: The commit added count_user_annotations and changed book_detail to include its result in serialization.
cases.summary: The annotation count helper had to feed the SPA book-detail response.

cases.evidence: The commit added the custom-column setter and changed the device state handler to call it.
cases.summary: Configured read-status writes had to be wired into the device state handler.

cases.evidence: The commit introduced schedule resolution and changed the settings handler to validate through it.
cases.summary: Schedule normalization had to be shared by settings persistence and scheduling.

cases.evidence: The commit changed device registration and wired progress-only updates into that helper.
cases.summary: Progress-only device observation had to reach the shared device registry.

cases.evidence: The backend response and the TypeScript shelf page changed together to expose and render sort options.
cases.expected_miss_reason: The map is intentionally scoped to cps Python and cannot name a frontend consumer.
cases.summary: A backend shelf response change required a TypeScript consumer change.

cases.evidence: The API handler began passing a public-shelf flag into an instance method that conditionally calls the new filter.
cases.expected_miss_reason: The dependency crosses an instance-method call and keyword-controlled branch; methods are folded into a class node and the receiver call is unresolved.
cases.summary: Public-shelf visibility propagated through an instance method and a keyword flag.

selection_method: Distinct real commits were inspected with git show --function-context. Each case records a changed cps function and a caller/consumer changed with it, including two known static-analysis blind spots.
